results.fact: Summit-day duration vs. its own timestamped schedule
results.evidence: Third attempt. Searches of guide pages, club trip reports and the peak's climber log found only descriptions of the Northeast Face as several pitches of snow and ice to about 60 degrees, best in early fall, and summit-day times for the standard East Ridge (3-5 hours camp to summit; one party under 2 hours up and 1 down). No source gives times for the face itself, so the day's 9 hours and its 12-hour clock schedule cannot be reconciled without inventing times.

results.fact: Distance up the Chiwawa River Trail to the Massie Lake turnoff: approach/itinerary/sectionBreakdown 'about 4 miles' vs the 'M' tree waypoint distMi 2.8 (and lake 4.7)
results.evidence: Third attempt. Figures for the Trinity-to-turnoff distance still do not converge: one high-route description says roughly 4 miles, a different party approx 3-4 miles, a summary cites about 3 miles, and a 2005 party describes a 1.4 mi leg plus a 3.1 mi leg before the lake path with the lake path itself 1.4 mi (another says ~2 mi). OpenStreetMap puts Massie Lake about 4.6 mi in a straight line from Trinity, which makes the lake pin's distMi 4.7 implausibly short for a trail-plus-sheep-path route, but no two sources state the same cumulative figure for either pin, and new distMi values would have to be computed, so nothing is changed.
